art_note: The image features a flat, computer-generated mock-up style typical of generic suppliers, failing to meet the high standards of a luxury fashion house.
desc_en: A contemporary reinterpretation of the classic silhouette. This piece presents a continuous graphic design that challenges traditional visual conventions. Crafted with recycled materials for the modern wardrobe. Each garment is made to order with worldwide shipping. Refined aesthetics define the house vision.
desc_es: Una reinterpretación contemporánea de la silueta clásica. Esta pieza presenta un diseño gráfico continuo que desafía las convenciones visuales tradicionales. Confeccionada con materiales reciclados para el guardarropa moderno. Cada prenda se elabora bajo pedido con envíos a todo el mundo. La estética depurada define la visión de la casa.
